summary: Fix the unreadable UI and add real motion. Measurement found two undefined tokens: --accent-ink (so primary buttons inherited a text colour - the dark-on-dark report) and --line (so all 11 borders fell back to the text colour, which is why blocks had no separation). The palette is re-derived against each mode's worst-case surface, the accent is split into fill/text/ink roles per accent, and a motion pass (spring easings, card lift, staggered chips, toast slide, reduced-motion respected) is added. Two regression tests now enforce WCAG AA contrast for every mode x accent x surface and that every CSS variable used is defined.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit c0dff9a. Static UI tokens/motion + a new test file; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: Presentation tokens, motion and tests only; no model call, no operation or ceiling change.
budget_impact.before: Undefined --accent-ink and --line; muted/good/bad/accent text below WCAG AA; minimal motion.
budget_impact.after: All pairs >=4.5:1 (worst-case surfaces, 5 accents x 2 modes); dividers defined; spring motion pass; regression tests.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: AA contrast for every mode x accent x surface; no undefined variables

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; design-system work, not recommendation quality
